claims: Gary Woodland underwent successful brain surgery in September 2023 to remove a lesion that was causing severe anxiety and fear.
Gary Woodland was diagnosed with PTSD following his recovery.
Gary Woodland returned to the PGA Tour in January 2024.
Gary Woodland won the 2026 Houston Open.
Gary Woodland was diagnosed with a lesion on his brain in 2023.
Gary Woodland's brain lesion was affecting the area controlling fear and anxiety.
Gary Woodland underwent surgery on September 19, 2023 to remove the tumor.
Surgeons removed part of the lesion during Gary Woodland's surgery.
Surgeons left some of the lesion to prevent potential loss of sight or motor function.
Gary Woodland missed 11 of 26 cuts in 2024.
In March 2026, Gary Woodland opened up about his ongoing battle with PTSD.
Gary Woodland won the Texas Children’s Houston Open.
The Texas Children’s Houston Open was Gary Woodland's first victory since 2019.
A 54-second TenGolf YouTube video dated March 29, 2026 shows Gary Woodland discussing his emotional journey after his win in Houston.
